title: The public preview for Dynamics 365 Business Central 2025 release wave 2 (BC27) is available
summary: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2025 release wave 2 (BC27) public preview is available for testing and feature review. Administrators can create preview sandboxes via the Business Central admin center, with the understanding that preview environments are temporary and cannot be promoted to production.
key_points: BC27 preview environment is now available for creation in the Business Central admin center
Preview sandboxes are for testing only and cannot be updated to production versions
The environment runs on W1 27.0 with Platform 27.0.38856.0 and Application 27.0.38460.38809
BC25 introduced more flexible major update management, extending the update window from 30-60 days to 5 months with optional minor updates

quotes.text: Business Central 2024 wave 2 (BC25): Manage environment updates more flexibly - Major update: 30(60) days -> 5-month
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the significant change in update management flexibility introduced in BC25, giving organizations more control over when to apply major updates.
